WITH base AS (
  SELECT rfistat, modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM base
),
grp AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM base
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_modindex
  FROM grp g
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE g.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT q.rfistat,
       q.avg_modindex,
       q.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS above_avg_by,
       q.avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying q
CROSS JOIN overall o
ORDER BY q.avg_modindex DESC;
